criteria.criterion: sign_manifest signs successfully when only UNRELATED tickets commit to the shared tracker throughout the attempt — verified by a test that actually commits an unrelated ticket event inside the window, WITHOUT monkeypatching tracker_head_sha to a constant.
sign_manifest signs successfully when an unrelated commit lands during lock acquisition (the under-lock-mismatch path) — same no-freezing constraint.
A genuine change to the subject's own or direct related material still fails closed with PlanReviewGenerationChanged and names the changed component (unchanged behaviour; companion test).

tracker_head_sha no longer returns store-read-failure because another process has files staged inside its own locked add→commit window; a caller's genuinely dirty tracked worktree still fails (unit tests both ways).
under_lock_check's mismatch is logged with a precise, distinguishable reason (generation drift), not a bare after="under-lock-mismatch" — asserted via caplog.
tests/unit/test_plan_review_generation_scope.py no longer freezes tracker_head_sha, so the invariant in its title is actually exercised.
